baselineEvidence.note: Re-baselined after performance plan Phase 1 (E2.6a, E3.2/E1.1, E2.8, E2.12, E1.3a, E2.9, E2.3) on the Phase 0 devbox. The previous baseline (2026-07-26, Ryzen 9 9950X) had case keys broken by a [Params] on ReadBenchmarks and an allocation budget CompileMaximumSource had already exceeded on main (978,904 B measured in Phase 0 against 884,360 B); that pre-existing allocation growth is carried into this baseline.

convenienceBaselineEvidence.environment: Linux Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS (Resolute Raccoon); AMD EPYC 9645; X64; .NET 10.0.10 (10.0.10, 10.0.1026.32716); SDK 10.0.302
convenienceBaselineEvidence.note: The runtime ParseAsync of the 28-byte record over a MemoryStream read in place (AsyncBenchmarks) and the generated view enumerator over 256 records (SequenceBenchmarks), category ReleaseGate, measured on the same devbox with the Gate job after the convenience plan's Phase 5 (24 samples each, RSD 5 % / 3 %). The tree differed from the recorded revision only by this contract, the ReleaseGate attribute on the enumerator case, and the performance-table renderer; the library and the benchmark bodies are those of the revision. The policy's minimum median budget and allocation headroom bound both cases; the enumerator's budget is the headroom alone since it allocates nothing.

baselineEvidence.note: Re-baselined 2026-09-20 from dotnet pack of the 0.7.0 source: the package now carries the [CStructLayout]/[CStructMapped] source generator and analyzer (analyzers/dotnet/cs/CStructSharp.Generators.dll, ~450 KB, the compile-time core compiled a second time for netstandard2.0) plus build/CStructSharp.props/.targets and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md; the maxima keep the ~5.3 % headroom of the previous baseline, rounded up to whole KiB; the gzip-equivalent totals are zlib level 9 sums. Re-baselined 2026-09-21 from dotnet pack of the 0.8.0 source (the convenience plan): the runtime assembly grew by ~75 KB raw per framework (the awaitable forms' async state machines, the record-sequence iterators, the ReadOnlySequence overloads, TryParse/ReadValue<T> support, the token checks) and its XML documentation by ~58 KB, the analyzer by ~41 KB (Records, the view enumerator, TryParse, the sequence emitter); the same ~5.3 % headroom rounded up to whole KiB.
